parties.respondent: State Rep. By The Deputy Superintendent of Police, Lalgudi Trichy & Ors.

summary: Application to quash SCI ST Act case; Sections 3(1)(r) and 3(1)(s) scrutiny; 'public view' interpretation per Swaran Singh, Hitesh Verma; office chamber not public view; colleagues present insufficient for public view; criminal proceedings quashed; no ingredients of SC ST Act offences made out; appeal allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: SC ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(r), s.3(1)(s)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; criminal proceedings quashed; High Court judgment set aside.
